subject: Unable to dispatch task for application XXXXX0, there are 1 tasks in progress

messages.author: 7df74fd07a628732
messages.subject: Unable to dispatch task for application XXXXX0, there are 1 tasks in progress
parts:
Hi,

I've been trying to deploy my first shinyapps dashboard, and was hitting a few errors along the way, but I followed answers from this page and Stack Overflow to get there.

My dashboard finally seemed to successfully deploy, but I was hitting a timeout error when I tried to open it:

Unable to connect to worker after 60.00 seconds; startup took too long.

Following that, I started hitting this error:

Unable to dispatch task for application XXXXX0, there are 1 tasks in progress

I tried deploying in another name, and this hit the same issues. I read a few responses on this site which said that the issue solved itself after a few hours, so I slept on it. However, I've woken up to the same issue. I currently have two dashboards on my account right now, and both are hitting the same error. I can't archive/delete either dashboard without hitting the same error, so I'm currently in limbo right now. Any ideas to fix this?

Thanks,
Nick
